detailed_description:
Photoreal cinematic live-action, 1881 London, 35 mm film grain, natural weight and pace.
[Shot 1] From 00:00 to 00:02. The shot begins from <Picture 2>: a wide down the second-floor corridor of Halliday's Private Hotel: a short narrow passage, a worn drugget runner over bare boards, dull green walls, one panelled bedroom door standing shut at the far end with a white china handle, grey morning light from the sash window at the near end. The camera is at the head of the stairs, level with a standing man's chest and five long strides from the bedroom door, a 35mm lens. The grey morning light comes from the sash window behind the camera. At the first frame A panelled bedroom door stands shut at the CENTRE of frame at the height of a standing man and a half with a white china handle, a worn drugget runner runs away down the CENTRE of the bare boards. The camera pushes in down the corridor across the whole shot, travelling four long strides as the low gas flame on the LEFT wall leans and steadies at a normal walking pace, from 00:00 to 00:01. At 00:01 the drugget runner comes up past the bottom of frame, and the movement continues to the last frame of the shot. By 00:02 the camera is pushing in down the corridor across the whole shot, travelling four long strides through the last frame of the shot, and the action continues with it.
[Shot 2] From 00:02 to 00:07. At 00:02 the shot cuts to an insert low on the bare boards at the foot of the bedroom door, beginning from <Picture 3>: a thin red ribbon of blood curling out from under the door across the drugget runner and pooling along the skirting at the far side; only what <Picture 3> shows is in frame. The camera is at the corridor floor, level with the skirting board and a forearm from the door, a 50mm lens. The low gas flame is the only light and it comes from the LEFT. At the first frame The bottom edge of a panelled door crosses the TOP of frame, a thin red ribbon of blood comes out from under it at the CENTRE at the width of a finger and runs across the drugget to a small pool at the skirting at the BOTTOM RIGHT, and the bare boards keep the rest. The camera tilts down a hand's breadth across the whole shot as the ribbon of blood creeps a thumb's width further along the skirting, from 00:02 to 00:04. At 00:04 the gaslight shifts once across the wet, and the movement continues to the last frame of the shot. By 00:07 the camera is tilting down a hand's breadth across the whole shot through the last frame of the shot, and the action continues with it.
